summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue with QuerySet.only() after select_related() crashing on proxy models by modifying how the meta options are accessed. The additional test files provide a good demonstration of the fix.

issues.description: The test files configure Django settings directly within the test scripts, which is not the conventional way to set up tests in Django. Typically, tests should be placed in a separate test module and use Django's testing framework.

The test scripts could be improved for readability and maintainability. For example, the creation of test data and the setup of the database schema could be moved into a separate setup function or a test case class.
